title: My attempt at my very first AI game : Rock80
author: zerohandoffs
selftext:
Hi all!  After years of building products with teams, I started doing AI side projects lately, and I started wondering if I could build a complete game entirely on my own with AI.

So here is attempt at my very first AI game : Rock80

Rock80 is about a garage rock band with no lead singer. You write songs with your bandmates, bring in a different guest vocalist for each one and then play them live as a rhythm game.   
  
**AI stack:**

* **Code:** written with Claude Code, mostly Opus 5.5 medium
* **Art:** everything made with GPT 2.5 Sunburst, I have some other workflows with Qwen2.1 when specific tasks needed like outpainting.
* **Voices:** ElevenLabs v4 for almost everything
* **Lyrics:** GPT-5.5. You can jam with the band (pick an idea, a story and a mood, and they write it with you), or write every word yourself.
* **Music:** YuE2 BF16. The reason it works for a rhythm game is that it plans the song as ABC notation before rendering the audio. That means I get the actual bars, tempo and structure as data, so I can build a note chart that lines up with the generated recording. The remaining offset between the plan and the real audio is measured automatically for every take. A model that only returns an audio file would have meant guessing the beats.

What’s still challenging: getting the gameplay to feel locked to the music. Making AI lyrics sound like rock lyrics instead of greeting cards. And keeping the art style consistent across hundreds of images. I spent a good amount of time researching and training on rock music lyrics, still not perfect but promising.

**H**ere’s one I made, a heavy metal track with the guest singer Rex Razor. It runs in the browser, no signup. [https://rock80.band/s/2026-10-16-a0eb88](https://rock80.band/s/2026-10-16-a0eb88)  
(The app version feels a lot better, but this gives you the idea.)  


**My next phase is alpha:** I’m planning a small closed alpha of 50–100 people. Players will be able to share their songs and even show up as guests in each other’s gigs.   
Waitlist: [https://rock80.band](https://rock80.band/)

Happy to go deep on any part of the pipeline. I’d love feedback, especially on the music and the note timing.

All the best, cheers.
